children: fell 3.30% premarket after raising its full-year sales and profit guidance and beating on the quarter. It reported second-quarter sales of $4.87 billion, up 1.1% and ahead of the $4.83 billion LSEG consensus. Comparable sales climbed 11.3% at Bloomingdale's and 6.2% at Bluemercury, while the namesake Macy's stores managed 1.1%.

Spring's Bold New Chapter strategy, launched in 2024, has pushed the company toward higher-margin product and full-price selling, closed weak stores and moved resources to stronger markets. Higher-income shoppers are still buying luxury apparel, handbags, fragrance and skincare.

Adjusted profit rose 80% to $0.63 per share, of which tariff refunds contributed $0.23. Macy's has collected $116 million in refunds so far, and said its raised guidance reflects that benefit alongside macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty that could affect consumer spending. Net sales are now guided to between $21.68 billion and $21.83 billion, up from $21.50 billion to $21.75 billion, with adjusted EPS at $2.15 to $2.35 against a prior $2.00 to $2.20.

title: Macy's Raises Outlook but the Stock Falls Anyway
